result.markdown:
If you mean **workers’ compensation lawyers specifically for an injured worker in Hobart**, I’d shortlist these firms rather than simply choosing the biggest law firm.

### My top Hobart shortlist

1. **LHD Lawyers Hobart — strongest specialist shortlist**
   - **4.8/5 from 127 local reviews** in the business results.
   - Their Hobart practice specifically handles workers’ compensation, including weekly payments, medical expenses, permanent impairment and common-law claims. [www.lhd.com.au](https://www.lhd.com.au/office-location/tas/hobart/workers-compensation/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[hallpayne.com.au](https://hallpayne.com.au/our-people/henry-pill/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[hallpayne.com.au](https://hallpayne.com.au/our-people/meghan-thomas-richards/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.blumers.com.au](https://www.blumers.com.au/work-injury/?state=TAS&utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - Their team includes **Jessica Medhurst**, who says she has specialised in workers’ compensation for seven years, and **Mark Rowbotham**, who has 22 years' experience in insurance/personal-injury litigation with a focus on workers' compensation. [www.lhd.com.au](https://www.lhd.com.au/team/jessica-medhurst/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - **My pick if your priority is specialist workers' comp expertise.**

2. **Hall Payne Lawyers Hobart — excellent for complicated/disputed claims**
   - **4.8/5 from 99 local reviews.**
   - Their Tasmanian practice explicitly handles workers' compensation disputes and claims. [hallpayne.com.au](https://hallpayne.com.au/areas-of-practice/workers-compensation/tas/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - **Henry Pill** has 15+ years' experience and has acted in significant Tasmanian workers' compensation matters. **Pierre Dordhain** specialises in workers' compensation and has appeared in the Workers' Compensation Tribunal, Federal Circuit Court and Tasmanian courts. [hallpayne.com.au](https://hallpayne.com.au/our-people/henry-pill/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - Hall Payne's **Meghan Thomas-Richards** was listed among *Three Best Rated's* 2025 compensation lawyers in Hobart, and the firm reports a significant 2025 Supreme Court workers' compensation win. [hallpayne.com.au](https://hallpayne.com.au/our-people/meghan-thomas-richards/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - **My pick if the insurer is fighting you or the matter is legally complex.**

3. **Blumers Personal Injury Lawyers — strong local personal-injury option**
   - **4.9/5 from 34 local reviews.**
   - The Hobart office specifically handles workers' compensation and common-law work-injury claims and says it has 25+ years' experience. [www.blumers.com.au](https://www.blumers.com.au/work-injury/?state=TAS&utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - **David Cocker**, a Hobart director/principal solicitor, practises in workers' compensation and common-law claims. [www.blumers.com.au](https://www.blumers.com.au/team/team-member/david-j-cocker/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - **Good choice if you want a smaller/local feel rather than a huge national firm.**

4. **Slater and Gordon Lawyers Hobart — established national option**
   - Hobart office at **111 Macquarie St** and a dedicated national workers' compensation practice. [www.slatergordon.com.au](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/offices/hobart?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.slatergordon.com.au](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/personal-injury/workers-compensation?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - They handle rejected claims, stopped payments, treatment disputes and potential common-law damages. [www.slatergordon.com.au](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/offices/hobart?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.slatergordon.com.au](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/personal-injury/workers-compensation?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - Their online customer feedback is mixed: recent reviews include very positive workers' compensation experiences, but there are also significant negative reviews, so I'd interview the actual lawyer/team handling your case rather than relying on the brand. [www.productreview.com.au](https://www.productreview.com.au/listings/slater-and-gordon?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### If it were my case

I'd get **2–3 free initial consultations** and compare:

- Who will actually run the file?
- How much of their practice is **Tasmanian workers' compensation**?
- Have they handled claims against your particular insurer?
- What are the prospects of a **lump-sum/common-law claim**, if applicable?
- What exactly does "no win, no fee" cover, including medical/expert costs?
- What percentage/amount of any settlement could ultimately go to legal costs?

**My first calls would be LHD and Hall Payne**, with Blumers as the third comparison.

One important point: workers' compensation law is **Tasmania-specific**, and deadlines can matter. LHD notes that claims generally need to be lodged within six months, subject to exceptions, so if you've already been injured or your payments have been stopped/rejected, don't wait for the "perfect" lawyer before getting advice. [www.lhd.com.au](https://www.lhd.com.au/office-location/tas/hobart/workers-compensation/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me **what happened (e.g. back injury, psychological injury, workplace accident, claim rejected, payments stopped, or you're considering a lump-sum/common-law claim)**, I can narrow this down to the **2 best Hobart lawyers for your particular situation** and compare their experience and fees.
